rv.q: The outcome is a startling theatrical gambit. On Johan Kølkjær’s truncated football-field set, the seven-strong — and I mean strong, athletic, indefatigable — cast members enact the sequential history of the West as initially populated by immigrants for whom great opportunities existed beyond the east coast.

vr.q: I was riveted from the first minute on
this piece unfortunately left me feeling a bit stranded
